title: pleopeltis lanceola
intro: Pleopeltis lanceola, commonly known as the lance-leaved polypody, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The lance-leaved polypody is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis lanceola include wound healing, immune system modulation, and antioxidant activity, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
